title: Disturbance-Adaptive Finite-Time Control of Three-Phase Rectifiers
summary: Three-phase AC-DC rectifiers are fundamental components in modern power electronics systems, yet achieving rapid voltage regulation and precise current tracking under load and grid disturbances remains challenging due to nonlinear dynamics and measurement uncertainties. This paper presents a finite-time control method for three-phase AC-DC rectifiers that achieves millisecond-scale regulation of DC-link voltage and grid currents under varying conditions.
